(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (border-cells obj)
      (append (for/list ([r (in-range (obj-r1 obj) (+ (obj-r2 obj) 1))]) (list r (obj-c1 obj)))
              (for/list ([r (in-range (obj-r1 obj) (+ (obj-r2 obj) 1))]) (list r (obj-c2 obj)))
              (for/list ([c (in-range (+ (obj-c1 obj) 1) (obj-c2 obj))]) (list (obj-r1 obj) c))
              (for/list ([c (in-range (+ (obj-c1 obj) 1) (obj-c2 obj))]) (list (obj-r2 obj) c))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([obj (in-list (objects g 0))])
      (paint-cells out (border-cells obj) (obj-color obj)))))
